_editingGuide.addProject: Copy one project object inside the projects array, paste it at the top for the newest project, and replace its values.
_editingGuide.jsonReminder: Use double quotes and place commas between project objects. Do not add a comma after the final object.

projects.name: On-Chip Filters for Hybrid Superconducting–Semiconducting Quantum Systems
projects.desc: Designed compact on-chip filters using niobium (Nb)-based coplanar waveguides on a silicon substrate to suppress 3–5 GHz microwave-photon leakage from an OCS transmon into nearby gate lines while preserving control signals up to 100 MHz. The design supports transmon-mediated coupling between triple quantum dots for scalable hybrid quantum-computing systems.

projects.name: Amplifier Module (22nm FinFET CMOS Tapeout)
projects.desc: Designed and simulated a 22 nm FinFET CMOS chip combining an analog amplifier, activation switches, and digital control logic, then completed the Cadence layout and DRC/LVS verification for tapeout.

projects.name: Multi-IC solar charging module
projects.desc: Completed the system-level design, schematics, and PCB layout for a multi-IC solar-charging module.
